description: Publish a post from this user's Nextcloud Social account. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. Supports replies, media attachments (see social_upload_media), polls, content warnings and visibility. Confirm the wording and the visibility with the user before calling this.

in_reply_to_id.description: The id of the status this replies to, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

language.description: ISO 639 language code of the post, e.g. en

poll.description: Attach a poll to the post

expires_in.description: Seconds until the poll closes, e.g. 86400 for a day

multiple.description: Allow more than one choice (default false)

spoiler_text.description: Content warning shown in place of the post until the reader expands it

visibility.description: Who sees it: public (world-readable and listed), unlisted, private (followers only), direct (mentioned accounts only). Omitted, the account’s default post privacy applies; a reply to a direct message is direct whatever this says

name: social_post_status
title: Post to the Fediverse
